nr_025: One name, two incompatible schemes. Of 15 _ulid() definitions, 13 return str(uuid.uuid4()).replace('-','').upper()[:26] — the first 26 hex characters of a random UUID4, not a ULID — and 2 are genuine Crockford-base32 ULIDs. Every declarative base uses the fake one; the real implementation mints no primary keys. A third reason not to copy the VARCHAR shape.
nr_023_root_cause_corrected: Cross-MetaData foreign keys, NOT a missing national core. All 24 unresolvable FK targets are mapped, just by a different MetaData than the referencing table. 18 distinct MetaData objects, 6 fail topological sort, 360 unresolvable references. Canonical repair is one shared MetaData, blocked by exactly one collision (NR-006).
